comments.author: @AB-wf8ek
comments.text:
I think the reason it messed up with the apple counting task, is that it can't decide whether the 7th apple belongs in the middle row or the bottom row.

When I was in college, the library was a tall building that only had books on every other floor. The reason for this is, when they were designing it back in the 70's, they didn't know whether to calculate the books as a live load or a dead load because they would be moving, but not all the time.

Because they never settled the debate, in the end they actually forgot to include the weight of the books altogether. Once construction was finished and they loaded in all the books, they realized the oversight once bricks started popping off the side of the building. In the end they were forced to only put books on every other floor.

On the right side of the road, there's a speed limit sign indicating "35 mph". Trees line both sides of the road. The sky has dark clouds, which might indicate impending rain. On the left side of the road, orange traffic cones can be seen, possibly signifying a construction or work zone. Further ahead, a bridge overpass is visible.
